regions.name: Tasmania
regions.quote: The Tasmanian giant freshwater crayfish is endemic to rivers and streams of northern Tasmania.

regions.name: Arthur River
regions.quote: It naturally occurs at altitudes below about 400 m and is distributed across the Arthur River and all other rivers and creeks draining into Bass Strait, including the Cam River, Forth-Wilmot River, Inglis River and Mersey River catchments, with the exception of the Tamar River catchment.
